title: DreamConfig
description: Schema for dream.config.json, the per-repo delta set that packages/compile compiles into the nightly Dream Machine routine. Mirrors the DreamConfig interface and validateConfig() rules in packages/compile/src/config.ts — keep both in sync by hand; packages/compile/src/dream-config-schema.test.ts fails if they drift.

$schema.description: Points editors at this file for autocomplete/validation. Not a DreamConfig field.

cron.description: 5-field UTC cron. The minute field must be a single fixed value (0-59) — minimum interval is 1 hour. validateConfig() trims surrounding whitespace before checking, so the pattern allows it too.

slots.description: Rotation slots, keyed by date % slots.length.

deep.description: The deep-dive surface for this rotation slot.

bonusModuli.description: Bonus deep-dives keyed by day-of-year modulus, e.g. { "25": "vertical-packs" }.

controlPlaneProbes.description: Shell probes for STEP 0.5 control-plane discovery.

buildStep.description: Optional build step run before discovery.

cmd.description: Shell command to build the checkout, e.g. "npm ci && npm run build".

degradeOnWasmFailure.description: If true, a wasm/NAPI build failure is a recorded degradation, not a stop.

bench.description: Command/glob for the benchmark corpus, e.g. an experiments run script.

flywheel.description: Flywheel gate entrypoint, if the target ships one.

adrConvention.description: ADR numbering + directory convention for STEP 19.

competitors.description: Competitor list injected into STEP 3 research.

ledgerPath.description: Path to the durable ledger. Default docs/dream-cycle/LEDGER.md.

branchPrefix.description: Branch prefix for candidate branches. Default "dream/".

autoMerge.description: If true, the guarded auto-merge policy is described in the PR step.
